items.headline: Albemarle has surprising new reason to rally
items.snippet: Mizuho raised its 2027 lithium demand estimate by almost 10%; Benchmark raised its 2027 lithium carbonate forecast to $22,500/t from $18,375. Q2 Energy Storage sales $1.28B, up 78%; realized price $19.53/kg, up 61%.

items.headline: Rocket Thrusters on a Road Car Arrive as EV Makers Split Into Winners and Laggards
items.snippet: On October 12, the most active lithium carbonate contract on the Guangzhou Futures Exchange fell 11.8% to 104,740 yuan per ton, lowest in nearly ten months; ALB fell 4.2% pre-market. Mizuho upgraded a day later. Q3 results due Wednesday, November 4.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory; raising 2027 Energy Storage price forecast to $21k from $17k and 2028 to $19k from $18k.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered PT to $135 from $230, keeps Buy. Lithium up ~67% y/y but well below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered PT to $175 from $200, keeps Outperform, following recent lithium spot price weakness; views group as oversold.
